usedFor: Sangam CRM holds your leads, and 8x8 texts them when “New Lead Created” runs “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Sangam CRM, then “Send SMS” in 8x8
bestTemplate.why: A new lead gets a text message, sent through your 8x8 account.

watchOut: “New Lead Created” in Sangam CRM is polling, so “Send SMS” goes out after a scheduled check.
